a_first_token_logprob.description: logprob of the first answer token

a_first_token_margin.description: p(top1) - p(top2) at the first answer position

a_length_normalized_logprob.description: total logprob under the Wu et al. length penalty

a_mean_logprob.description: mean per-token logprob over the answer span

a_mean_top5_entropy.description: mean truncated predictive entropy over answer positions

a_min_logprob.description: least-likely answer token; the weakest link in the span

a_perplexity.description: exp(-mean logprob) over the answer span

a_total_logprob.description: sum of answer-token logprobs, i.e. log P(answer)

b_disagreement_rate.description: fraction of samples whose normalized answer differs from greedy

b_distinct_count.description: number of distinct normalized answers in the answer set

b_distinct_fraction.description: distinct count divided by answer-set size

b_mean_pairwise_f1.description: mean token F1 over all unordered pairs in the answer set

b_semantic_entropy_normalized.description: semantic entropy divided by ln(answer-set size)

c_p_true_plain.description: renormalized P(True) shown only the proposed answer

c_p_true_with_samples.description: renormalized P(True) also shown the N sampled answers

t_random.description: seeded uniform noise; the null signal
